articles.text: PEDRO: Juguemos sólo nueve hoyos hoy. Tengo que marcharme temprano.
PEDRO: Let's play only nine holes today. I have to leave early.
JAIME: Vengamos a jugar otra vez mañana. Yo quiero aprender.
JAIME: Let's come play again tomorrow. I want to learn.
PEDRO: Muy bien. Te llamo a las cinco.
PEDRO: Very well. I'll call you at five.
JAIME: Are you crazy? That early?
PEDRO: Sí, tienes que ser madrugador si quieres aprender.
PEDRO: Yes, you have to be an early riser if you want to learn.
